title: Telia to shed 168 jobs in Finland as restructuring takes effect
content: The changes will see the termination of a total of 251 positions at the company, while 83 new roles will be created.

title: Telia to cut up to 600 jobs - report - DCD
content: The layoffs are set to impact around 215 jobs in Sweden, plus 280 roles in Finland. Details around the remaining layoffs were not reported.

title: 600 jobs may be cut at Telia in first quarter of 2026
content: 600 jobs may be cut at Telia in the first quarter of 2026, the company has informed its employees. In Sweden, this affects around 215 jobs.

title: Telia May Cut 200 Jobs in Finland - TT - MarketScreener
content: Telecom operator Telia has initiated restructuring negotiations in Finland that could result in a net loss of 200 jobs, according to TT.
